name: Skate with Santa at the Omni Center
cost: Free; donations requested for the Onalaska school food pantry
paras: The Omni Center in Onalaska hosts Skate with Santa on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 PM at 255 Riders Club Rd.
Skating is free, and donations for the Onalaska school food pantry are requested. Families lace up for an evening on the ice with Santa.

name: Jingle Bell Jamboree at the Onalaska YMCA
cost: Check with the YMCA for admission
paras: The La Crosse Area Family YMCA invites families to its Jingle Bell Jamboree on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM at the Onalaska YMCA.
The evening has festive crafts, games and a bounce house for the whole family.
tip: Check the YMCA page for admission details.

name: Santa and Mrs. Claus Visit at Altra in Onalaska
when_note: Tuesday, December 1, 3 to 7 PM, and Saturday, December 5, 9 AM to noon
paras: Santa and Mrs. Claus visit Altra's Onalaska Operations Center at 1700 Oak Forest Dr. on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 3 to 7 PM.
A second visit follows on Saturday, December 5, from 9 AM to noon, so families can choose a weeknight or a Saturday morning.
tip: Pick the Saturday morning for a calmer visit.

name: Neenah-Menasha Fire Rescue Santa Float
address: Neighborhood routes in Neenah and Menasha, WI
when_note: Evenings, November 30 to December 11, 2026 (no float December 5 or 6); the December 3 route starts at 5:45 PM after the Gather Round event
paras: The Neenah-Menasha Fire Rescue Santa Float rolls through a different neighborhood each evening from November 30 through December 11, 2026, with no float on December 5 and 6.

Menasha routes run November 30 to December 3, and Neenah routes run December 3 to 11. The December 3 route begins at 5:45 PM after a stop at the Gather Round event, and on December 8 the float visits Children's Hospital at Theda Clark first. Watching is free, and donations go to the Neenah-Menasha Charitable Foundation.
tip: Check the fire rescue site for each night's streets.

name: Nativity Festival in Janesville
host: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
venue: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
when_note: Friday to Sunday, December 4 to 6, 2026, 4 to 8 PM; children's story time Saturday 4:30 to 5:30 PM
paras: The annual Nativity Festival fills the church at 3001 N. Wright Rd. in Janesville from December 4 to 6, 2026, with festival hours of 4 to 8 PM each night.
Families see nativity displays, enjoy music and join Children's Story Time on Saturday, December 5, from 4:30 to 5:30 PM. A Christmas concert follows on Saturday at 6 PM, and admission is free.
tip: Come Saturday at 4:30 PM for story time.

name: 12 Daze of Christmas at Bryden Motors
cost: $8 donation for a 4 by 6 pet photo with Santa; bring a new toy
paras: Bryden Motors of Beloit holds its 12 Daze of Christmas toy drive on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 11 AM to 3 PM at 548 Broad St.

Bring a new, unwrapped toy for the Salvation Army of Rock County and take a photo with Santa. Kids and pets are both welcome, and a 4 by 6 photo is an $8 donation to A Promise of Love Pet Rescue. There is also a bake sale, live music and a 50/50 raffle.
tip: Bring a new unwrapped toy to donate.
